intro.h2: A Chicago bathroom crew that knows condo boards and old plumbing
paragraphs: Wood Contracting handles bathroom remodeling in Chicago for high-rise condos, townhomes and vintage single-family homes. Owner Dillon Wood oversees every job himself, and the work is done by his in-house tradespeople, not rotating subcontractors. The team pulls the permits, files the HOA paperwork, books the freight elevator and plans around building water shutoffs.

Most bathrooms take 2 to 5 weeks from demolition to completion. Tile is where the crew stands out: reviewers on Google tag tiling more than any other skill, and recent jobs range from a small kids' bath to a pair of fully gutted baths in one condo. About 90 percent of new projects come from referrals and repeat clients.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Chicago, plus kitchens and carpentry

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Cosmetic updates through full gut remodels: walk-in showers, custom tile, floating vanities, waterproofing and all plumbing and electrical. Small condo baths get layouts that make every inch count. The site lists a typical range of $12,000 to $55,000+ depending on scope and finishes.

image.alt: Chicago guest bathroom remodel with marble-look wall tile, wood double vanity, brass-framed mirrors and brass faucets

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Custom kitchens for downtown lofts and classic Chicago homes, from cabinet layout to counters and lighting. Most kitchen remodels run 4 to 6 weeks. Dillon's crew handled this South Loop loft, pairing wood-grain upper cabinets with navy lowers and the building's original brick.

image.alt: South Loop Chicago loft kitchen remodel with wood-grain upper cabinets, navy lower cabinets, white quartz peninsula and exposed brick wall

items.name: Condo Remodeling
items.blurb: Downtown condos bring HOA approvals, work-hour limits, elevator bookings and units below you to protect. Wood Contracting has completed dozens of condo bathroom projects from River North to Gold Coast and manages the building coordination so the job does not stall.

image.alt: South Loop Chicago condo bathroom remodel with marble-look shower walls, wood vanity, brass mirrors and wall sconces

items.name: Whole Home Remodeling
items.blurb: Larger projects that open up floor plans or add living space, managed start to finish by the same team. On this Logan Square job the crew turned a third-floor outdoor patio into conditioned living space wrapped in floor-to-ceiling windows.

image.alt: Logan Square Chicago patio converted to an indoor room with floor-to-ceiling black-framed windows and light wood flooring

items.name: Basement Finishing
items.blurb: Unused basements become family rooms, wet bars and playrooms. The team works through Chicago codes and handles moisture, structural and mechanical issues before finishes go in, as in this Lincoln Park basement with a navy wet bar and built-in media wall.

image.alt: Finished basement in Lincoln Park, Chicago with navy wet bar, beverage fridge, white built-in shelving and wall-mounted TV

items.name: Custom Cabinets and Carpentry
items.blurb: Built-ins that add storage and character, from bookcases to window seats. In Bucktown the crew framed a fireplace with white shelving and lower cabinets on both sides, and finish carpentry like this shows up in their bathroom and kitchen work as well.

image.alt: Bucktown Chicago living room with custom white built-in shelves and cabinets flanking a fireplace

why_choose_us.h2: What sets this crew apart on Chicago jobs

items.title: Dillon is on every job
items.text: Every consultation starts with Dillon Wood in person, not a salesperson. He oversees each project through the final walkthrough, so the person responsible for the result is the one you talk to.

items.title: Itemized, plain pricing
items.text: Each proposal breaks out scope, timeline and cost line by line. A Google reviewer called the team extremely transparent about costs and timeline, and flexible when the schedule had to move.

items.title: Licensed, insured, lead-safe
items.text: Wood Contracting holds Illinois general contractor licence TGC105501, is EPA Lead-Safe certified, and carries liability insurance and workers' compensation. The firm lists a BBB A+ rating.

items.title: A 1-year workmanship warranty
items.text: Installation and construction are covered for one year after the final review. Product warranties come from the manufacturers, and any punch-list items are handled during the final walkthrough.

about.h2: Meet Dillon Wood, owner and general contractor
about.text: Dillon Wood owns Wood Contracting Chicago and brings more than three decades of remodeling experience to the work. He runs the company as an owner-operated shop: he meets you at the first consultation, oversees the build and keeps communication direct. His crew of in-house tradespeople has completed more than 500 residential remodels in Chicago. For design, Dillon partners with experienced designers including Emily Andersson Design, or works with your own designer. The firm belongs to the Wicker Park Bucktown and Lincoln Park chambers of commerce.

process.h2: Five steps from site visit to final walkthrough

steps.title: Free estimate
steps.text: A site visit to see your space, take measurements and walk through your options, with a free, no-commitment estimate.

steps.title: Itemized proposal
steps.text: You receive a clear proposal that breaks down the full scope of work, the timeline and the costs.

steps.title: Design selection
steps.text: Choose materials, finishes and fixtures with the team or your own designer while permits, HOA and building coordination are handled.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The in-house crew completes the work, with Dillon or your project manager keeping you updated at every stage.

steps.title: Final review
steps.text: You walk the finished space together, any items are fixed right away, and the 1-year workmanship warranty begins.

service_area.h2: Chicago neighborhoods where Dillon's crew works
service_area.text: Most projects are in downtown and North Side neighborhoods, from South Loop lofts and Printer's Row conversions to Lincoln Park greystones and Old Town cottages. The firm's service area runs across Cook County from Hyde Park to Evanston. Each building type has its own approval rules and plumbing quirks, and the crew plans for them before the first wall opens. If your home is outside this list, call and ask.

faq.h2: Questions Chicago homeowners ask Wood Contracting

items.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take in Chicago?
items.a: Most bathrooms take 2 to 5 weeks from demolition to completion, and kitchens usually take 4 to 6 weeks. City permits, when needed, add roughly 2 to 4 weeks of review before work starts. You get a detailed timeline at the free consultation, and the crew works to hold it.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel cost?
items.a: The site lists bathroom remodels from about $12,000 to $55,000+, depending on size and finishes. A powder room update sits at the low end and a primary bath with custom features at the high end. Kitchens generally run $15,000 to $80,000+. Your proposal is itemized so you see where the money goes.

items.q: Can you work in my condo building?
items.a: Yes. Condo work is a large share of the business. The team handles HOA submissions, building coordination, elevator reservations and work-hour rules, and uses waterproofing that protects the units below. One reviewer chose the firm partly because Dillon already knew their building.

items.q: Can I stay home during the remodel?
items.a: Most clients do. The crew contains dust, protects the rest of your home and cleans up every day. Some disruption is unavoidable, especially during a kitchen remodel, but the team plans the work to keep it as small as possible.

items.q: What if you find damage behind the walls?
items.a: Older Chicago buildings can hide water damage, outdated wiring or structural problems. If something turns up during demolition, the team stops to explain your options, prices the repair clearly and moves forward only once you agree. There are no hidden fees added at the end.

final_cta.h2: Talk to Dillon about your bathroom
final_cta.text: Call (312) 405-5837 to book a free site visit and estimate, or send your project details and the team will follow up.
